vibe_rationale: Long-running design, vintage and makers' market with live music and food, but heavily sponsor-branded with more than 50 brand partners.
fit_notes: An adult creative and family shopping crowd, with food, beauty and wellbeing brands already partnering, so non-endemic precedent is strong. The free monthly stall format lets a brand test cheaply and repeat, but each brand would have low standout, and it would need a local partner.
